api/GenerativeAI.Clients.html.summary: Namespace GenerativeAI.Clients Classes AgentApiClientBase Shared plumbing of the clients of the agent-related Gemini API resources (Voices, Agents, Environments, Triggers, Credentials and Decisions), which — like the Interactions API — use snake_case JSON and live directly under the API version ({base}/{version}/{collection}, or .../projects/{project}/locations/{location}/{collection} on Vertex AI). AgentsClient A client for the managed Agents API (/agents): create reusable agent definitions (base agent, agent configuration, system instruction, tools and base environment) and reference them from interactions. Follows python-genai's client.agents (experimental). AuthTokensClient Creates ephemeral auth tokens for the Live API, so client-side apps (browsers, mobile apps) can open Live sessions without holding your API key. Gemini API only; uses the v1alpha API. BaseClient Represents the base implementation for API clients that interact with an underlying platform. This class provides shared functionality such as HTTP communication and authorization handling to its derived client classes. BatchClient A client for interacting with the Gemini API Batch endpoint. Provides methods for creating, managing, and monitoring batch processing jobs. CachingClient A client for interacting with the Gemini API Caching endpoint. ChunkClient A client for interacting with the Chunks API. CorporaClient A client for interacting with the Gemini API Corpora endpoint. CorporaManager The CorpusManager class provides a client interface for managing corpora, documents, chunks, and permissions within a generative AI platform. It supports creating, retrieving, listing, querying, and deleting entities related to the corpus resources. CorpusPermissionClient A client for interacting with the Corpus Permissions endpoint. CredentialsClient A client for the Credentials API (/credentials): store secrets (environment variables, bearer tokens, OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens) that agent environments can use without exposing them. Secrets are write-only. Follows python-genai's client.credentials (experimental). DecisionsClient A client for the Decisions API (POST /decisions): evaluates structured questions (yes/no "NOUL", choice and score) against a shared multimodal input with a decision model such as GeminiDecision1, returning calibrated probabilities. Follows python-genai's client.decisions. DocumentsClient A client for interacting with the Documents API. EnvironmentsClient A client for the Environments API (/environments): sandbox environments used by agent interactions, with mounted sources (e.g. your own GCS bucket, inline files, repositories) and workspace files that can be listed, uploaded (resumable upload, optionally extracting a tar archive) and downloaded. Follows python-genai's client.environments (experimental). FileClient A client for interacting with the Gemini API Files endpoint. FileSearchStoresClient A client for the Gemini API File Search stores and documents endpoints (managed retrieval-augmented generation). ImageTextModel Provides functionality for image-to-text generative AI tasks including image captioning and visual question answering (VQA). Offers methods to interact with both local image files and images hosted on cloud storage. ImagenModel A client for interacting with the Imagen API to generate images. InteractionsClient A client for the Gemini Interactions API (/interactions): stateful model and agent interactions (e.g. Deep Research, Antigravity) with server-side state, background execution, Server-Sent Event streaming, stream resumption and continuation of long decodes. Works with the Gemini Developer API and Vertex AI. ModelClient A client for interacting with the Gemini API Models endpoint. OperationsClient Provides functionality for interacting with long-running operations. The OperationsClient allows for querying, listing, canceling, and deleting operations on a given platform. Remarks McpTool connects to an MCP server via the official C# SDK and automatically discovers and exposes all available tools from that server. When the model requests to call a function, McpTool forwards the request to the MCP server and returns the response. Example usage with stdio transport: var transport = McpTransportFactory.CreateStdioTransport( "my-server", "npx", new[] { "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything" } ); using var mcpTool = await McpTool.CreateAsync(transport); var model = new GenerativeModel(apiKey, GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash); model.AddFunctionTool(mcpTool); var result = await model.GenerateContentAsync("Your query here"); Example usage with HTTP transport: var transport = McpTransportFactory.CreateHttpTransport("http://localhost:8080"); using var mcpTool = await McpTool.CreateAsync(transport); // Use as above Properties Client Gets the MCP client instance. api/GenerativeAI.Types.JobState.html.title: Enum JobState | Google GenerativeAI .NET SDK
api/GenerativeAI.Types.JobState.html.summary: Enum JobState Namespace GenerativeAI.Types Assembly GenerativeAI.dll Job state enumeration representing the lifecycle states of a job. Supports both BATCH_STATE_* (Google AI) and JOB_STATE_* (Vertex AI) formats. [JsonConverter(typeof(JobStateConverter))] public enum JobState Extension Methods MicrosoftExtensions.ToJsonNodeResponse(object?) ObjectExtensions.ToSchema(object, JsonSerializerOptions?) Fields JOB_STATE_UNSPECIFIED = 0 The job state is unspecified. JOB_STATE_QUEUED = 1 The job has been just created or resumed and processing has not yet begun. JOB_STATE_PENDING = 2 The service is preparing to run the job. JOB_STATE_RUNNING = 3 The job is in progress. JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED = 4 The job completed successfully. JOB_STATE_FAILED = 5 The job failed. JOB_STATE_CANCELLING = 6 The job is being cancelled. From this state the job may only go to either JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED, JOB_STATE_FAILED or JOB_STATE_CANCELLED. JOB_STATE_CANCELLED = 7 The job has been cancelled. JOB_STATE_PAUSED = 8 The job has been stopped, and can be resumed. JOB_STATE_EXPIRED = 9 The job has expired. JOB_STATE_UPDATING = 10 The job is being updated. Only jobs in the JOB_STATE_RUNNING state can be updated. After updating, the job goes back to the JOB_STATE_RUNNING state. JOB_STATE_PARTIALLY_SUCCEEDED = 11 The job is partially succeeded, some results may be missing due to errors.

If there is a need to mix data interleaved across the LiveClientContent and the LiveClientRealtimeInput, the server attempts to optimize for best response, but there are no guarantees. api/GenerativeAI.Types.html.summary: Namespace GenerativeAI.Types Classes ActivityEnd Marks the end of user activity. This can only be sent if automatic (i.e. server-side) activity detection is disabled. ActivityStart Marks the start of user activity. This can only be sent if automatic (i.e. server-side) activity detection is disabled. Agent A managed agent (/agents): a reusable agent definition (base agent, configuration, system instruction, tools and base environment) that interactions can reference by ID. AgentApisSerializerContext Source-generated JSON metadata for the agent-related API types (Voices, Agents, Environments, Triggers, Credentials and Decisions). The clients of these APIs put it first in their resolver chain (followed by InteractionsSerializerContext for the shared Interactions types), so they work with Native AOT and trimming. AgentEnvironment A sandbox environment (/environments) used by agent interactions, with its mounted sources and workspace files. Named AgentEnvironment to avoid clashing with Environment. AntigravityAgentConfig Configuration of the Antigravity agent (antigravity). ApiKeyConfig Config for authentication with API key. AsyncBatchEmbedContentRequest Request for batch embedding generation. AttributionSourceId Identifier for the source contributing to this attribution. AudioChunk Representation of an audio chunk. AudioResponseFormat Format of audio output. AudioTranscriptionConfig Configuration settings for audio transcription in multimodal live sessions. AuthConfig Auth configuration to run the extension. AuthConfigGoogleServiceAccountConfig Config for Google Service Account Authentication. AuthConfigHttpBasicAuthConfig Config for HTTP Basic Authentication. AuthConfigOauthConfig Config for user oauth. AuthConfigOidcConfig Config for user OIDC auth. AuthToken An ephemeral auth token for the Live API. Pass Name as the API key of a GoogleAIPlatformAdapter used by a Live client; the client then connects to the constrained endpoint. AutoRoutingMode When automated routing is specified, the routing will be determined by the pretrained routing model and customer provided model routing preference. AutomaticActivityDetection Configures automatic detection of activity. AutoraterConfig Autorater config used for model evaluation during tuning. AvatarConfig Configures the avatar to be used in the live session. BatchBigQueryDestination BigQuery destination for batch output. BatchBigQuerySource BigQuery source for batch input. BatchConfig Batch configuration containing input config. BatchContentOutput Output wrapper for content generation batch jobs. BatchContentResponsesWrapper Wrapper for content generation batch responses (nested structure). BatchCreateChunksRequest Represents a request to batch create chunks. BatchCreateChunksResponse Represents the response from a batch create chunks operation. BatchDeleteChunksRequest Represents a request to batch delete chunks. BatchEmbedContentRequest Represents a batched request for embedding content. BatchEmbedContentsResponse Represents the response to a BatchEmbedContentRequest. BatchEmbeddingOutput Output wrapper for embedding batch jobs. BatchEmbeddingResponsesWrapper Wrapper for embedding batch responses (nested structure). BatchGcsDestination GCS destination for batch output. BatchGcsSource GCS source for batch input. BatchGenerateContentRequest Request for batch content generation. BatchInputConfig Input configuration for a batch job (Google AI / MLDev format). BatchJob Represents a batch processing job for generating content or embeddings at scale. Batch jobs allow processing large numbers of requests asynchronously. BatchJobDestination Configuration for the output data destination of a batch job. BatchJobResponse Response wrapper for batch job operations (Google AI format). BatchJobResponseConverter Custom JSON converter for BatchJobResponse that handles dynamic response parsing based on the metadata type field. BatchJobSource Configuration for the input data source of a batch job. BatchOutputInfo Information about the output of a batch prediction job (Vertex AI only). BatchStats Statistics about a batch job's progress. BatchUpdateChunksRequest Represents the request body for batch updating chunks. BatchUpdateChunksResponse Represents the response body for batch updating chunks. BatchWrapper Wrapper for batch request (Google AI / MLDev format). BearerTokenCredentialConfig An HTTP bearer token (bearer_token). Blob Raw media bytes. Text should not be sent as raw bytes, use the 'text' field. CachedContent Content that has been preprocessed and can be used in subsequent requests to GenerativeService. Cached content can be only used with the model it was created for. Candidate A response candidate generated from the model. ChatSessionBackUpData Represents a backup object for a chat session containing session-related data and configurations. Checkpoint Describes the machine learning model version checkpoint. ChoiceDecisionAnswer The answer to a ChoiceDecisionQuestion (choice). ChoiceDecisionQuestion A multiple-choice question (choice). Chunk A Chunk is a subpart of a Document that is treated as an independent unit for the purposes of vector representation and storage. A Corpus can have a maximum of 1 million Chunks. ChunkData Extracted data that represents the Chunk content. ChunkingConfig Tells the service how to split a file into chunks when adding it to a FileSearchStore. CitationMetadata A collection of source attributions for a piece of content. CitationSource A citation to a source for a portion of a specific response. CodeExecutionResult Result of executing the ExecutableCode. Only generated when using the CodeExecutionTool, and always follows a Part containing the ExecutableCode. CodeExecutionTool Tool that executes code generated by the model, and automatically returns the result to the model. See also ExecutableCode and CodeExecutionResult which are only generated when using this tool. CodeMenderAgentConfig Configuration of the CodeMender agent (code-mender). CodeMenderFindRequest Parameters of a CodeMender FIND session. CodeMenderFixRequest Parameters of a CodeMender FIX session. CodeMenderSessionConfig CodeMender session configuration. CodeMenderSourceFile A source file given to the CodeMender agent. CompositeReinforcementTuningRewardConfig A composite (weighted) reward function configuration for reinforcement tuning. CompositeReinforcementTuningRewardConfigWeightedRewardConfig A weighted single reward configuration inside a CompositeReinforcementTuningRewardConfig. LiveClientContent Incremental update of the current conversation delivered from the client. All of the content here is unconditionally appended to the conversation history and used as part of the prompt to the model to generate content. A message here will interrupt any current model generation. LiveClientContextUpdate Updates to the context of the current live session. Only fields that are set will be updated. Updates are guaranteed to be processed in order with the rest of the inputs. LiveClientMessage Represents the payload for a bidirectional client interaction. This class is used to encapsulate data such as the setup, client content, real-time input, and tool responses that are involved in bidirectional communication. LiveClientRealtimeInput User input that is sent in real time. This is different from LiveClientContent in a few ways: Can be sent continuously without interruption to model generation. If there is a need to mix data interleaved across the LiveClientContent and the LiveClientRealtimeInput, the server attempts to optimize for best response, but there are no guarantees. End of turn is not explicitly specified, but is rather derived from user activity (for example, end of speech). Even before the end of turn, the data is processed incrementally to optimize for a fast start of the response from the model. Is always direct user input that is sent in real time. Can be sent continuously without interruptions. The model automatically detects the beginning and the end of user speech and starts or terminates streaming the response accordingly. Data is processed incrementally as it arrives, minimizing latency. LiveClientSetup Message to be sent in the first and only first client message. Contains configuration that will apply for the duration of the streaming session. Clients should wait for a LiveServerSetupComplete message before sending any additional messages. LiveClientToolResponse Client generated response to a LiveServerToolCall received from the server. Individual FunctionResponse objects are matched to the respective FunctionCall objects by the id field. Note that in the unary and server-streaming GenerateContent APIs function calling happens by exchanging the Content parts, while in the bidi GenerateContent APIs function calling happens over these dedicated set of messages. api/GenerativeAI.Utility.MarkdownExtract.summary: Class MarkdownExtractor Namespace GenerativeAI.Utility Assembly GenerativeAI.dll The MarkdownExtractor class provides functionality to extract code blocks from markdown content. The extracted code blocks can include fenced code blocks with specified programming languages and indented code blocks. Code blocks can include fenced code blocks with a specific language tag as well as indented code blocks. public static List<CodeBlock> ExtractCodeBlocks(string markdown, string languageFilter = "*") Parameters markdown string The markdown content from which code blocks will be extracted. languageFilter string An optional filter to extract only code blocks of a specific programming language. Use "*" to extract code blocks of any language. Returns List<CodeBlock> A list of CodeBlock objects, each representing a code segment with details about its programming language and line number. ExtractJsonBlocks(string) Extracts JSON blocks (objects or arrays) from a given text. api/GenerativeAI.html.summary: Namespace GenerativeAI Classes ApiVersions Represents a static class containing string constants for different versions of the API. These versions are to be used across the application for interacting with services or constructing API request URLs where versioning is required. BaseModel The BaseModel class is an abstract representation of the model interactions in the GenerativeAI library. It serves as a foundational implementation that enables derived classes to interact with the GenerativeAI platform. This class inherits from BaseClient. It provides protected methods for use by derived classes, allowing them to handle content generation, token management, and content embedding functionalities. BaseModel is designed for flexible extension, enabling the development of specific AI model implementations. BaseUrls Provides constant URLs used as base endpoints for various AI platform services in the GenerativeAI namespace. This class contains static members that define the foundational endpoints required for API calls in services implementing generative and AI capabilities. ChatSession ContentExtensions Provides extension methods for the Content class, allowing operations such as adding parts, handling inline and remote files, adding text, and extracting code or JSON blocks. ContentRequestExtensions Contains extension methods for working with objects implementing IContentsRequest. DefaultSerializerOptions Represents a class providing default JSON serializer options for consistent serialization and deserialization behavior across the application. EmbeddingModel Represents a machine learning model for generating embeddings from input text or content. This model allows handling of single or batch embedding operations using various input types or formats. Inherits from the BaseModel class. EnvironmentVariables The EnvironmentVariables class provides access to various environment variables used for configuring Google AI services. These variables store information such as project ID, region, API keys, and authentication credentials. Default values are used for certain variables if they are not set. FilesConstants Defines a collection of constants representing supported MIME types for various file operations within the API. FunctionCallExtensions Provides extension methods for working with function call-related types. GeminiModel The GeminiModel class is a specialized implementation of the GenerativeModel, designed to provide capabilities for generative AI tasks. It supports multiple constructors for flexibility, allowing users to configure the model according to their specific requirements, including platform, API key, configuration, safety settings, and various other parameters. GenAI Represents the base class for generative AI services. This class provides a framework for generative AI capabilities, including the management of AI models, creation of generative and embedding models, and interacting with generative AI infrastructure. GenerateAnswerResponseExtension Provides extension methods for GenerateAnswerResponse objects. GenerateContentRequestExtensions Provides extension methods for enhancing the functionality of the GenerateContentRequest class. GenerateContentResponseExtensions Provides extension methods for the GenerateContentResponse type in the GenerativeAI.Types namespace. GenerateImageRequestExtensions Provides extension methods for the GenerateImageRequest class. GenerativeModel A Generative AI Model that extends BaseModel GenerativeModelTasks The GenerativeModelTasks class defines a set of constant task names used to interact with generative AI models. These tasks are used across various operations for processing and generating content, embeddings, and token analysis. GoogleAICredentials Represents the credentials required to authenticate with Google AI Generative APIs. This class encapsulates the API key and an optional access token necessary for making authorized API calls. GoogleAIModels Provides constants for Gemini model variations and related information. GoogleAIModels.Agents Provides constants for Gemini agent models. GoogleAIModels.Experimental Provides constants for experimental Gemini model variations. GoogleAIModels.Imagen Provides constants for Imagen model variations. GoogleAIModels.Music Provides constants for Lyria music generation models. GoogleAIModels.Video Provides constants for video generation model variations. GoogleAIPlatformAdapter The GoogleAIPlatformAdapter class provides an implementation of the IPlatformAdapter interface to integrate with Google AI Generative API. It handles authorization, URL generation, and credential management for making requests to the Google AI platform. GoogleAi The GoogleAI class serves as the main entry point for interacting with Google's AI models. It provides methods to create generative and embedding models, as well as manage and retrieve model details. This class integrates Google's AI platform capabilities by utilizing appropriate models and configurations to handle generative AI tasks, embeddings, and other related operations. ImageCaptioningRequestExtensions Extension methods for configuring ImageCaptioningRequest objects with image data. ImageConfigValues Provides common values for image generation configuration. These constants are provided for convenience and discoverability but are not restrictive; any valid string value accepted by the API can be used. ImageConfigValues.AspectRatios Common aspect ratios for image generation. ImageConfigValues.ImageSizes Output resolutions for image generation. Only supported on certain models like gemini-3-pro-image-preview. ImageConfigValues.OutputMimeTypes Output MIME types for generated images. ImportRagFilesRequestExtensions Extension methods for adding various data sources to an ImportRagFilesRequest. InlineMimeTypes Contains constants and configurations for inline file handling, including file size limitations and allowed MIME types. JsonElementExtensions Provides extension methods for JsonElement objects. MarkdownCodeExtractorExtension Provides extension methods for extracting structured data, such as code blocks and JSON blocks, from markdown strings. ObjectExtensions Provides extension methods for working with objects in the GenerativeAI library. Includes utilities for converting objects into schema representations. RagCorpusExtensions Extension methods for configuring the RagCorpus with different vector database configurations. RequestExtensions A static class providing extension methods for formatting request contents used in generative AI models. Roles Defines constant role identifiers used in the Generative AI system. SemanticRetrieverChatSession Represents a chat session that interacts with a semantic retriever model to generate answers based on user queries. Includes functionality for maintaining session history, managing configurations, and handling responses from the model. SemanticRetrieverModel Represents a semantic retriever model used for working with documents, corpora, chunks, and corpus permissions. This model requires a platform adapter with authentication for initialization. StringExtensions Provides extension methods for string-related model manipulations. SupportedEmbedingModels Provides a centralized collection of supported embedding model identifiers for use in the GenerativeAI namespace. VertexAI Represents the Vertex AI implementation of the generative AI platform. VertexAIModel VertexAIModel is a specialized class for interacting with Google's Vertex AI generative models. It extends the functionality of the GenerativeModel class and serves as a concrete implementation for initializing and utilizing Vertex AI's capabilities for content generation tasks. VertexAIModels Provides constants for Vertex AI model variations and related information. VertexAIModels.Codey Provides constants for Codey model variations. VertexAIModels.Embeddings Provides constants for Embeddings model variations. VertexAIModels.Gemini Provides constants for Gemini model variations. VertexAIModels.Gemma Provides constants for Gemma model variations. VertexAIModels.Imagen Provides constants for Imagen model variations. VertexAIModels.MedLM Provides constants for MedLM model variations. VertexAIModels.Video Provides constants for video generation model names. VertextPlatformAdapter The VertextPlatformAdapter class provides authentication, configuration, and utility methods for interacting with Vertex AI. VideoGenerationModel A client for interacting with the Gemini API for video generation tasks. Note: Video generation capabilities might be specific to certain API versions or platforms (e.g., Vertex AI). VqaRequestExtensions Extension methods for adding image data to a VqaRequest object. Interfaces IGenerativeAI Represents an interface defining operations for generative AI systems, including initializing models, retrieving model details, listing available models, and accessing platform-specific adapters. IGenerativeModel Defines the contract for a generative AI model. This interface provides methods for generating answers and content, streaming content, and counting tokens within inputs or outputs. It also includes properties for configuring behavior related to grounding, external tools, and advanced options such as JSON mode or function calling.
